subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 10: Over to you! and Review
outcomes: I can read readers' comments and find the ones about sport.
I can write a comment about Unit 1.
I can use the Present simple and Present continuous correctly.

tf.s: John is reading a book about cycling.
tf.why: Yes! John's comment is about cycling.

tf.s: Henry wants to learn to ski after reading the article.
tf.why: Correct! Henry wants to try skiing.

tf.s: The comment about painting and art classes is about sport.
tf.why: Painting is a hobby, not a sport.

tf.s: One reader started a karate club because he or she wanted friends to be healthy.
tf.why: Right! The club helps friends stay healthy.

tf.s: "I am usually doing karate after school" is correct.
tf.why: For routines we say "I usually do karate after school."

tf.s: "I'm watching a film at the moment" is correct.
tf.why: Yes! At the moment = Present continuous.
Correct! We use go with scooting.

tf.s: "She likes sport, but she prefers making models" uses state verbs.
tf.why: Yes, like and prefer are state verbs.

tf.s: "My parents eats sandwiches every day" is correct.

boxes.q: Which child is reading a book about cycling?

boxes.why: One reader wrote about snorkelling in Oman.

boxes.q: Which word is a state verb?
We ___ doing karate at the moment.
I liked the interview ___ it was exciting.

mcq.q: Which comment is not about sport?
o: the comment about painting and art classes

mcq.q: Who wants to learn to ski after reading the article?

o: do the gardening, play badminton, go scooting
go the gardening, do badminton, play scooting
play the gardening, go badminton, do scooting
do the gardening, go badminton, play scooting
mcq.why: Each activity has its own verb.

mcq.q: Which sentence is a good opinion comment?
o: I liked the interview about cycling because it was exciting.
mcq.why: I liked … because … gives an opinion and a reason.

mcq.q: Write a question: you / study / French / every week?
o: Do you study French every week?
Are you study French every week?
Does you study French every week?
Do you studying French every week?

mcq.q: Make a sentence: I / watch / a film / at the moment.
o: I'm watching a film at the moment.
I watch a film at the moment.
I watching a film at the moment.
I'm watch a film at the moment.

mcq.q: Make a sentence: my parents / eat / sandwiches / every day.
o: My parents eat sandwiches every day.
My parents eats sandwiches every day.
My parents are eating sandwiches every day.
My parents eating sandwiches every day.

mcq.q: What is wrong with "I am usually doing karate after school"?
o: "Usually" shows a routine, so we need the Present simple.

mcq.q: Why did one reader start a karate club at lunch time?
o: He or she wanted friends to be healthy.
He or she wanted to stop doing sport.
He or she was bored with karate.
He or she wanted to read about painting.
mcq.why: The club was to help friends be healthy.

mcq.q: Which is the best new answer to the WOW! Question "Why do we do sports and hobbies?"
o: To keep healthy and to relax, and they teach us teamwork.
mcq.why: Good reasons: health, relaxing and teamwork.
